newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: CRICKET-BORDER 35-0 IN REPLY TO TRANSVAAL'S 291.
newsitem.headline: CRICKET-BORDER 35-0 IN REPLY TO TRANSVAAL'S 291.

text.p: Transvaal all-rounder Ross Veenstra recorded a maiden first-class century on a rain-ruined second day of his side's Supersport Series match with Border in East London on Monday.

Veenstra added 45 to his overnight score to be undefeated on 135 as Transvaal were finally bowled out for 291. Border were 35 without loss when rain -- which allowed only 29 overs in the day -- finally washed out play at tea.
Veenstra shared a 54-run ninth wicket partnership with Clive Eksteen (11) to continue the repair work he began on Sunday with Andrew Hall.
He came to the wicket at 54 for five but stayed just short of six hours, hitting 17 fours. This eclipsed his previous highest innings of 75 for Natal B against Western Province B two seasons ago.
His previous highest "A" grade score had been 49 for another of his former provinces, Eastern Province, in 1992/93.
